title: Degree-six K3 Hilbert-square limits of general Debarre-Voisin deformations of the orthogonal trace trivector
source_title: Hilbert squares of K3 surfaces and Debarre-Voisin varieties
author: Olivier Debarre; Frédéric Han; Kieran O’Grady; Claire Voisin
difficulty_reason: The trace trivector has a smooth six-dimensional excessive zero locus identified with the Hilbert square of a quadric. Singular-Grassmannian restrictions identify its rank-two excess bundle globally with the cubic tautological bundle, and the full local excess-family construction realizes a general cubic K3 Hilbert square as the smooth central limit.
